items.title: Forgetting is Not Always Bad: A Neuro-Inspired Memory Repair Mechanism for Poisoned LLM Agents
items.one_liner: DREAM is a neuro-inspired, training-free memory repair framework that protects LLM agents from backdoor and poisoning attacks with high efficiency.
items.summary: Researchers have introduced DREAM (Dynamic Reactivation for Engram Attenuation in Memory), a training-free memory repair framework designed to protect LLM agents against memory-poisoning and backdoor attacks. Inspired by neuroscientific memory reconsolidation, DREAM operates via a three-stage pipeline involving perturbation-induced implicit reactivation, adaptive anomaly diagnosis using activation patterns, and dynamic memory repair that suppresses malicious entries while reinforcing benign ones. Experiments show DREAM reduces attack success rates by over 95% against backdoor poisoning while achieving up to a 2.13x speedup and 37.7% token reduction compared to existing baselines like A-MemGuard. The framework effectively secures multi-agent systems and maintains high task utility without external isolation modules.
